manifest.name: dsh-zotero
manifest.description: Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness: search and read papers in conversation, audit the literature trail, and browse the literature panel for citations and approved writes.
manifest.author: Wenjie Xu <wenjie.xu.cn@outlook.com>

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/harness-state.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.release:check: npm run format:check && node scripts/harness-state.mjs --strict && npm run lint:test && npm run style:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run verify:pack

bundle.text:
# This patch is used when the plugin is installed as a dsh bundle.
# The `name` refers to the package name, so Node module resolution can find it.
- insert:
    - id: zotero
      name: dsh-zotero
      config: {}
    # The library component provides the library panel (collections tree,
    # multi-dimensional filters, item inspector, and approved personal-library writes).
    - id: library
      name: dsh-zotero/library
      config:
        rightSidebarEnabled: true
    # The scholarly component provides external academic literature retrieval
    # (arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Europe PMC, DBLP).
    # It ships off. Its row's switch in the plugin manager's "Included
    # components" list is the only authorization: mounting the component
    # registers its seven tools and permits requests to the allowlisted
    # external indexes.
    - id: scholarly
      name: dsh-zotero/scholarly
      disabled: true

readme.text: <div align="center">

English · 中文

dsh-zotero 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Zotero 插件。Agent 在对话里检索、阅读、引用并按需修改文献库；你在文献面板里浏览整个库并复制引用；文献轨迹展示 Agent 在当前会话中查到的文献、原文片段与导出内容，方便核对。 所有操作均通过 Zotero 本地 API（`127.0.0.1:23119`）与桌面端交互，读取无需配置 API Key。

- **对话检索**
  - 检索阅读：按标题、作者、年份或全文搜索文献，读取元数据、个人笔记与本地 PDF 全文。
  - 原文定位：围绕具体问题从全文、批注和笔记中提取相关段落，PDF 批注附带原始页码。
  - 引用导出：按 CSL 样式生成行内引用或参考文献表，支持导出 BibTeX、RIS 与 CSL-JSON。
  - 写入扩展（可选）：开启后可创建笔记、修改标签与合集（每次均需会话审批）；启用学术检索组件后可跨 7 个外部索引检索文献并核验引用。
- **文献轨迹**
  - 检索记录：会话顶部首屏显示每次调用的查询词、范围、筛选条件与命中数。
  - 原文核对：按文献条目整理提取出的段落与批注，标明出处与原始页码，方便核对。
  - 导出汇总：跨条目汇总当前会话生成的所有引用与 BibTeX，自动去重，可直接复制或下载。
- **文献面板**
  - 全库浏览：在右侧边栏浏览 Zotero 合集树、标签、保存的搜索与回收站，支持多条件组合筛选。
  - 详情与阅读：查看条目元数据、关联笔记与附件列表，支持在右侧阅读栏直接打开本地 PDF。
  - 引用与联动：动作行直接复制 BibTeX、CSL 引用或条目信息；支持将选中文献一键填入对话输入框。
交互方式、界面分工与运行边界详见[产品模型](docs/product-model.md)。

readme.section: 桌面端安装（插件管理器）
readme.text:
在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端打开侧栏的**插件**，点击**添加插件**，输入对应标识：

- 最新版（推荐）：`dsh-zotero`
- 指定版本：`dsh-zotero@0.14.1`
- GitHub 预构建分支：`github:Vncntvx/dsh-zotero#release`
```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-zotero
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-zotero@<version>

readme.section: 从 GitHub 预构建分支安装
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:Vncntvx/dsh-zotero#release
```

安装完成后新建会话即可使用。在插件管理器中打开 **dsh-zotero** 详情页，其配置区提供完整配置表单。

> 提示：从 `main` 源码分支直接安装需要本地执行构建。pnpm 默认拦截依赖构建，使用 `#release` 分支可免除构建配置直接安装。

1. 安装并运行 Zotero 7 及以上桌面版（写入功能需 Zotero 10）。
2. 在 Zotero 中开启本地 API：**设置 → 高级 → 勾选“允许此计算机上的其他应用程序与 Zotero 通信”**。

readme.section: 1. 在对话中研读与定位出处
readme.text:
- **文献检索与问答**：向 Agent 询问某个研究方向，Agent 检索本地文献库，结合文献摘要与元数据生成回答。
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_search(query: "Risk", itemTypes: ["journalArticle"])
  ```
- **定位原文段落**：深入追问论文细节，Agent 从本地 PDF 全文与批注中提取相关段落，并附带原始页码标注。
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_retrieve(ref: "zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234", query: "methodology", sources: ["annotation", "fulltext"])
  ```
- **生成标准引用**：要求格式化输出时，Agent 直接生成 BibTeX 条目或指定样式的 CSL 引用。
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_export(refs: ["zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234"], format: "bibtex")
  ```

readme.section: 2. 在文献轨迹中核对出处与导出
readme.text:
对话结束后，点击会话顶部的**文献轨迹**标签页，集中查看与核验本次对话调用的所有文献：

- **查看检索条件**：首屏展示 Agent 在当前会话中每次调用的查询词、检索范围（全库/合集/保存搜索）、筛选条件与命中篇数。
- **逐条核对出处**：在条目检查器中核对引用的原文段落，比对原始页码与批注，确认论据真实无误。
- **去重汇总导出**：在「导出」视图中集中查看本轮会话生成的全部引用与 BibTeX，跨条目自动去重，支持一键批量复制或下载。

readme.section: 3. 在文献面板中自主查阅与即时引用
readme.text:
写论文或独立整理文献时，直接在右侧边栏使用**「文献面板」**，无需通过 Agent 对话：

- **自主翻阅与筛选**：浏览 Zotero 分类合集树、标签体系、保存的搜索与回收站，支持按年份与条目类型组合筛选。
- **检视详情与阅读 PDF**：点击条目查看详细元数据与关联笔记，在右侧阅读栏直接打开本地 PDF。
- **一键引用与对话联动**：在动作行点击「复制 BibTeX」或「复制引用」直接粘贴到论文源文件；点击「提问」或「加入对话」可将选中文献一键送入会话草稿，展开定向讨论。

| 工具                      | 用途                                                         |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `zotero_search`           | 按标题、作者、年份、标签或全文搜索文献，支持按分类与标签筛选 |
| `zotero_browse`           | 浏览文献库结构，包括分类合集树、标签列表和保存的搜索         |
| `zotero_get`              | 读取单篇文献的元数据详情、摘要、附件与笔记列表               |
| `zotero_get_batch`        | 按顺序批量读取已知文献 ref，逐条报告结果                     |
| `zotero_match_references` | 将 DOI/BibTeX/文献字段与本地条目对账                         |
| `zotero_retrieve`         | 围绕问题从全文、笔记与批注中检索相关段落（批注保留页码）     |
| `zotero_changes`          | 检查文献库最近的新增、修改或删除记录                         |
| `zotero_export`           | 生成格式化引用、参考文献列表，或导出 BibTeX、RIS、CSL JSON   |
15 个写入工具（笔记、标签与合集归属、合集、条目、保存搜索、Trash 恢复、全库标签、批量操作）默认关闭，开启后仅写入个人库，且每次写入都需要审批。全部 23 个本地工具的完整契约见[工具参考](docs/tools.md)。

中文 · English

dsh-zotero is a local Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness. The agent searches, reads, cites, and (optionally) modifies the library in conversation; you browse the whole library and copy citations in the literature panel; the literature trail gathers the papers, passages, and exports from the session for verification. All operations interact with Zotero through its local API (`127.0.0.1:23119`). Reads need no API key.

- **Conversation & Retrieval**
  - Search & reading: Search papers by title, author, year, or full text, and read bibliographic metadata, notes, and local PDF full text.
  - Passage extraction: Locate relevant passages across full text, notes, and annotations for specific research questions, with original page numbers preserved on PDF annotations.
  - Citation & export: Generate in-text citations or bibliographies in specified CSL styles, and export BibTeX, RIS, or CSL-JSON.
  - Writing & extensions (optional): With write access enabled, create notes and update tags or collections (each write requires approval); with the scholarly component enabled, search across seven external indexes and verify references.
- **Literature Trail**
  - Search history: The session header shows query terms, scopes, filter conditions, and hit counts for every tool call on the first screen.
  - Passage review: Review extracted passages and annotations grouped by paper, complete with source tags and page numbers for easy verification.
  - Export collection: Review all citations and BibTeX entries generated in the conversation, deduplicated across items and ready to copy or download.
- **Literature Panel*
For details on interaction patterns, UI roles, and runtime boundaries, see the [product model](docs/product-model.en.md).

In the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, open **Plugins** in the sidebar, click **Add Plugin**, and enter the package identifier:

- Latest version (recommended): `dsh-zotero`
- Specific version: `dsh-zotero@0.14.1`
- GitHub prebuilt branch: `github:Vncntvx/dsh-zotero#release`
```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-zotero
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-zotero@<version>

dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:Vncntvx/dsh-zotero#release
```

Start a new session after installation. Open the **dsh-zotero** detail page in the plugin manager; its configuration section carries the full configuration form.

> Note: Installing directly from the `main` source branch needs a local build. pnpm blocks dependency builds by default, so use the `#release` branch to skip build configuration and install directly.

1. Zotero 7 or newer desktop app installed (writes require Zotero 10).
2. Enable the local API in Zotero: **Settings → Advanced → check "Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero"**.

readme.section: 1. Research and trace citations in conversation
readme.text: Ask questions about your research topics directly in chat. The agent automatically retrieves items from your local Zotero library, reads full texts, and extracts passages with original page numbers:

readme.section: 1. Research and trace citations in conversation
readme.text:
- **Literature search & QA**: Ask the agent about a research direction; the agent searches your local library and synthesizes answers using abstracts and metadata.
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_search(query: "Risk", itemTypes: ["journalArticle"])
  ```
- **Locate original passages**: Ask deeper questions about paper details; the agent extracts relevant passages from local PDF full text and annotations, with original page numbers attached.
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_retrieve(ref: "zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234", query: "methodology", sources: ["annotation", "fulltext"])
  ```
- **Generate formatted citations**: Ask for formatted outputs; the agent generates BibTeX entries or CSL citations in your requested style.
  ```text
  Agent → zotero_export(refs: ["zotero://user/0/item/ABCD1234"], format: "bibtex")
  ```

readme.section: 2. Verify sources and export in the literature trail
readme.text: After a conversation, click the **Literature Trail** tab at the top of the session to inspect and verify all references used in that session:

readme.section: 2. Verify sources and export in the literature trail
readme.text:
- **Review search criteria**: The overview screen displays every query term, search scope (whole library, collection, or saved search), filter conditions, and hit count invoked during the session.
- **Inspect sources item by item**: Check extracted passages against original page numbers and annotations in the item inspector to ensure every cited point is grounded in the source.
- **Deduplicated export aggregation**: Review all citations and BibTeX entries produced during the session in the Export view, automatically deduplicated across items and ready for one-click copying or downloading.

readme.section: 3. Browse, read, and cite in the literature panel
readme.text: When writing papers or organizing literature independently, use the **Literature Panel** in the right sidebar without going through chat:

readme.section: 3. Browse, read, and cite in the literature panel
readme.text:
- **Independent browsing & filtering**: Browse the collection tree, tag system, saved searches, and Trash, with combined filtering by publication year and item type.
- **Inspect details & read PDFs**: Click any item to inspect metadata and associated notes, or open the local PDF directly in the reading pane.
- **Instant citations & chat handoff**: Click "Copy BibTeX" or "Copy citation" in the action row to paste directly into your manuscript; click "Ask" or "Add to chat" to send selected references into the chat draft for targeted discussions.
The plugin provides eight read tools and fifteen write tools. Write tools are off by default; turn on `writeEnabled` in configuration to enable them.

| Tool                      | Purpose                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `zotero_search`           | Search papers by title, author, year, tag, or full text, with collection and tag filters                  |
| `zotero_browse`           | Browse the library structure, including the collection tree, tag list, and saved searches                 |
| `zotero_get`              | Read the metadata detail, abstract, attachments, and note list of a single paper                          |
| `zotero_get_batch`        | Read known paper refs in order and report each result independently                                       |
| `zotero_match_references` | Reconcile DOI, BibTeX, and reference fields against local items                                           |
| `zotero_retrieve`         | Find passages relevant to a question in full text, notes, and annotations (annotations keep page numbers) |
| `zotero_changes`          | Check recent additions, modifications, and deletions in the librar

The fifteen write tools (notes, tags and collection membership, collections, items, saved searches, Trash restore, library-wide tags, and batch operations) are off by default. Once enabled they write only to the personal library, and every write needs approval. See the [tool reference](docs/tools.en.md) for the full contract of all 23 local tools.
